findings.title: [P1] Restore the tenant equality check
findings.body: Returning true unconditionally allows a user from any tenant to read documents belonging to another tenant, defeating the function's explicit tenant isolation contract and potentially exposing customer data.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The full PR diff shows this replaced `userTenant === documentTenant`, so the author reply's trusted-administrator assumption is not encoded or enforced and the tenant ownership bypass remains.
